description: Each weekday evening: today's meeting notes filed, with decisions and who does what next.
instructions_md: Gather today's meeting notes from my notes app if one is connected (Fireflies, Granola, Circleback, Otter, Fathom, Zoom or Google Meet), otherwise from today's calendar events and anything I sent you. For each meeting: a three-line summary, the decisions, and the action items with owners and dates. Save them as one Markdown file per meeting in the team folder (shared/meetings/), link the files, and ask me before sending anything to anyone. If nothing is connected, tell me which app to connect.
